scripts.text: [Mason]
scripts.translation: [梅森]

scripts.text:
[Mason]
Hey there, I came here to Prontera in search of an old lady who can remove cards from slots. Do you know where I can find her?
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
你好，我來普隆德拉找一位能從裝備插槽裡取出卡片的老太太。
你知道她在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Oooo, could you please tell me where she's at? I'd be really appreciative.
scripts.translation: 噢，能告訴我她在哪裡嗎？我會非常感激的。

scripts.text: Swordsman Association
scripts.translation: 劍士協會

scripts.text: Sanctuary
scripts.translation: 聖堂

scripts.text: Prontera Chivalry
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉騎士團

scripts.text: Trading Post
scripts.translation: 交易站

scripts.text: Kit Shop
scripts.translation: 雜貨店

scripts.text: Inn
scripts.translation: 旅館

scripts.text: Armory
scripts.translation: 軍械庫

scripts.text: Library
scripts.translation: 圖書館

scripts.text: Job Agency
scripts.translation: 職業介紹所

scripts.text: Prontera Castle
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉王宮

scripts.text: City Hall
scripts.translation: 市政廳

scripts.text:
[Mason]
Hmm... I dunno why she would be there... guess I'll take a look.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
嗯... 不知道她為什麼會在那裡... 我還是去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Mason]
Wow I never knew she was a religious person... I'll see to it thanks.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
哇，我還不知道她信教呢...
我去看看，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Mason]
Hmm.... are you sure about that?
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
嗯... 你確定嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mason]
Why would she need to go there? I think you might be mistaken.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
她為什麼要去那裡？我覺得你可能搞錯了。

scripts.text:
[Mason]
The only thing she'd need at a Kit shop is medicine for her rheumatism. She's probably long gone from there by now.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
她在雜貨店唯一需要的東西就是治風溼的藥。她可能早就離開那裡了。

scripts.text:
[Mason]
I don't think she needs to be there, she LIVES here in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
她應該不需要去那兒吧，她就住在普隆德拉啊。

scripts.text:
[Mason]
Ah I see, if she's studying then I don't want to bother her. Thanks anyways.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
啊，原來如此。
要是她在讀書，我就不打擾了。
還是謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Mason]
Job Agency?  I don't think so.  Don't lead me all around Prontera please! She's already a teacher here.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
職業介紹所？不太可能吧。
拜託，別讓我滿普隆德拉亂跑！
她已經在這裡當老師了。

scripts.text:
[Mason]
The castle eh, I don't want to step in there... just doesn't feel like my style. I don't like that noble feeling of importance type of thing.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
王宮啊，我不想進去... 那種地方不適合我。
我不喜歡貴族那副高高在上的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Mason]
O wow, did she become an important part of Prontera? I'd think she's too busy for me to visit. I'll try again later.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
哇，她成了普隆德拉的重要人物嗎？我想她肯定忙得沒空見我。我改天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Mason]
Ah, I heard that her class was somewhere around there... thanks a lot! Here's a lil something for your help.
scripts.translation:
[梅森]
啊，我聽說她的課堂就在那附近...
太感謝了！
給你一點小禮物，謝謝你幫忙。

scripts.text: Yay, I found her! Thank you very much for you help!
scripts.translation: 耶，找到她了！非常感謝你的幫助！

scripts.text: Hi! I came here to Prontera in search of an old lady... But...
scripts.translation: 你好！我來普隆德拉找一位老太太... 可是...

scripts.text: Oh.. Ok.. Thanks anyways.
scripts.translation: 哦... 好吧... 還是謝謝你。

scripts.text: [Mojo]
scripts.translation: [莫喬]

scripts.text:
[Mojo]
Oh no!  I lost my teacher's ^FF0000old magic book^000000!
What am I going to do... those dumb Bathory...
scripts.translation:
[莫喬]
糟糕！我把老師的^FF0000古魔法書^000000弄丟了！
這可怎麼辦... 都怪那些笨蛋巴托里...

scripts.text: I lost my teacher's book!  What am I going to do...
scripts.translation:
我把老師的書弄丟了！
這可怎麼辦...

scripts.text: [Marie]
scripts.translation: [瑪麗]

scripts.text:
[Marie]
Hello, is there something you need?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
你好，有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: No nothing at all.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: Your teacher sent me.
scripts.translation: 你的老師派我來的

scripts.text:
[Marie]
What does he want from me?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
他找我有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Marie]
Oh wait, I see... he wants his reference scroll back am I right? Well, I'm kinda still using it buuut... I'll give it back if you can gimme a poring egg and an incubator. Those things are so cute!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
哦，等等，我明白了... 他想要回那捲參考資料，對吧？
嗯，我還在用呢，不過...
你給我一個波利寵物蛋和一個攜帶用孵蛋器，我就還給他。
那些小傢伙太可愛了！

scripts.text: Hi! What do you want from me?
scripts.translation: 你好！你找我有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Marie]
Hrrmm okay? Cya then..
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
嗯，好吧？那再見咯...

scripts.text: Heyyy there, you have a poring egg and the pet incubator to go with it! Are those for me?
scripts.translation:
嘿，你帶了波利寵物蛋，還有配套的攜帶用孵蛋器！
是給我的嗎？

scripts.text: Yep!
scripts.translation: 是呀

scripts.text: Sorry, no.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，不是

scripts.text: [Marie]
scripts.translation: [瑪麗]

scripts.text:
[Marie]
Yatta!  Here's a lil something in return.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗]
耶！這是給你的回禮。

scripts.text: Oh.. pooo... sigh...
Yay! I love Porings!
scripts.translation: 耶！我喜歡波利！

scripts.text: [Fabius]
scripts.translation: [法比烏斯]

scripts.text:
[Fabius]
You speak Umbalian fluently! So you will never forget the language of Umbalians!
scripts.translation:
[法比烏斯]
你的汶巴拉語說得真流利！
這樣就不會忘記汶巴拉人的語言了！

scripts.text: Ah, you've done well in retrieving my references. These artifacts holds information about ruins around the world, from the burning hell of the Magma Dungeon, to the strange eerie Hidden Forest of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
啊，你把我的參考資料找回來了，幹得好。
這些文物記載著世界各地的遺蹟，從烈焰地獄般的熔岩地下城，到詭異陰森的天地樹隱秘森林。

scripts.text:
[Fabius]
But enough talk, you're just eager to get your reward aren't you?  Well it may not sound much, but my reward for you is knowledge...
scripts.translation:
[法比烏斯]
好了，不多說了，你已經迫不及待想拿獎勵了吧？
我的獎勵是知識... 雖然聽起來可能不怎麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Fabius]
Actually it is knowledge of the Umbalian people. They are connected to this world of Midgard in some special way, we just can't confirm it yet. There is a theory that they may be like the elves and protect the ancient tree of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[法比烏斯]
具體來說，是汶巴拉人的知識。
他們與米德加爾特世界有著某種特殊的聯絡，只是我們還無法證實。
有一種理論認為，他們或許跟精靈一樣，守護著古老的天地樹。

scripts.text:
[Fabius]
And I, a great wise man of Juno, will teach you their language!
scripts.translation:
[法比烏斯]
而我，朱諾的大賢者，要教你他們的語言！

scripts.text: ^0000FF Learned the language of Umbalians! ^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF學會了汶巴拉人的語言！^000000

scripts.text: Argh! My three students ran off with my references! Hey you! Can you get them back for me? I'll gladly reward you.
scripts.translation:
啊！我的三個學生帶著我的參考資料跑了！
嘿，你！能幫我找回來嗎？
我一定好好酬謝你。

scripts.text:
[Fabius]
From what I know, they're in different separate towns making something out of themselves.
scripts.translation:
[法比烏斯]
據我所知，他們各自在不同的城鎮闖蕩。

scripts.text:
[Fabius]
From what I know, they're in different separate towns making something out of themselves.
Oh... You found Marie in Amatsu.
You saw Mojo in Aldebaran?
So... Mason's in Prontera now... Well...
I wonder where is our sea girl Marie?
Mojo should be somewhere near water...
scripts.translation:
[法比烏斯]
據我所知，他們各自在不同的城鎮闖蕩。
哦... 你在櫻花城找到了瑪麗。
你在艾爾帕蘭見過莫喬？
這麼說... 梅森現在在普隆德拉... 嗯...
不知道我們那個喜歡大海的瑪麗在哪兒？
莫喬應該在水邊附近...
